text:
Jordi: Midday capacity pulse — quick notes.

Jordi: Yesterday: prewarmed AMS1 +8 GPUs after the spike, trimmed default batch size from 128 -> 112 to shave tail latency.
Jordi: Blocker: APAC spot eviction wave knocked out ~18% of our prewarm in APAC-S. Autoscaler retried but failed due to quota limit. Need a transient quota bump + confirmation that AZ fallback path is ready.
Priya: Filing cloud quota request (#CL-2247) now — asked for +12 GPUs APAC-S. Added urgency, ETA ~3-6h.
Sam: Can you paste the autoscaler change you made so I can review?
Jordi: Sure — small tweak we pushed last night: 
```yaml
policy:
  target_util: 0.62
  cooldown_seconds: 45
  max_replicas_delta: 6
```
Jordi: The idea was to be more conservative on scale-ups to avoid oversubscription during spot churn.
prewarm-bot: prewarm job 3922113344 applied -> AMS1: +8 GPUs :white_check_mark: (started 8 nodes)
Alex: If the quota bump is slow, we should route a small % (2-5%) of APAC traffic to the dedicated GPU pool as a temporary fallback. Routing change is nonbreaking but needs a quick policy PR.
Priya: Good call. Opening routing-ops PR and will assign to @Alex to add the rule + docs.
Alex: ACK — will draft the PR and include a canary flag. Also will update the rollout policy in the console.
ops-oncall: I'll keep an eye on evictions and latency. If evictions > 12% for > 15m I will initiate a manual fallback and ping infra rotation.
Jordi: Today's plan: 1) validate autoscaler logs for failures and rollback if necessary; 2) confirm quota ticket progress; 3) run a 5% canary to dedicated pool if cloud quota ETA slips. Will post EOD summary.
Priya: Cool. If quota comes through earlier we'll scale back the canary.
Sam: lgtm. If anyone needs me to quick-review the routing PR ping here.
Jordi: Thanks all — dropping the logs I looked at for context:
```
[2026-03-17T10:12:02Z] autoscaler: scale-up attempt -> requested 6 -> cloud quota denied (insufficient quota)
[2026-03-17T10:12:35Z] autoscaler: retrying scale-up after backoff
[2026-03-17T10:15:01Z] autoscaler: scale-up succeeded -> allocated 2 (partial)
```
Priya: noted, adding logs to the ticket.
Alex: 👍 :rocket:
Jordi: will update thread when quota moves or canary is live.
